```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Republican President Theodore Roosevelt predicted that America's future was in the Pacific.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America's future in the Pacific can develop peacefully only under the shield of American Naval and Air power.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration plans to significantly curtail production of the most advanced combat aircraft.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration plans to decommission 6 of 60 Air Force tactical squadrons.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration plans to eliminate critical air mobility assets, including 27 giant C-5As and 65 C-130s.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration plans to divest the nation of the brand new C-27.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President plans to reduce naval forces by retiring seven cruisers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The President plans to slow work on amphibious ships and attack submarines.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The President plans to reduce ground forces by separating 100,000 soldiers and Marines.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Many of the 100,000 soldiers and Marines will be discharged after recently returning from combat.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Another 100,000 ground forces will be reduced under the sequester.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"These plans limit strategic flexibility in an increasingly dangerous world.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The current President is repeating the disastrous cuts of the post-Vietnam war era.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The cuts put the nation in danger of returning to the \"hollow force\" of the Carter Administration.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"During the Carter Administration, the U.S. military was not respected in the world.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
